rules.statement: A commissioner appointed under the Partition Ordinance is a statutory public servant within the meaning of section 183 of the Penal Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "I have come to the conclusion that a commissioner appointed under the Partition Ordinance comes within the seventh class of persons mentioned in section 19 of the Penal Code, and as such is a statutory public servant."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 19 of the Ceylon Penal Code, class 7
